subject: ancient human skull lying on the ground, centuries old, the lower jaw missing: a real human cranium with its true anatomy, deep dark eye sockets, a dark triangular nasal opening, cheekbones, a few worn upper teeth, a crack across the brow and a small piece broken from the back of the vault; aged bone, dirty ivory to tobacco brown, darker and earth-stained underneath, dust in its crevices, matte and dry, never white
